title: Kapa Channel Island
safeHtml:
'''Kapa Channel Island''' is an artificial island on which Kapa Channel Station and its corresponding Premium Lounge is located.

Location

'''Kapa Channel Island''' is located directly to the south of Styrgate Road near a Bus Stop. In terms of districts, it is located to the north of West Metropolis Archipelago, the west of Odyssey and the east of Peckern North.

Transport

Railway

Kapa Channel Station is the station that serves as the railway hub of this island. It is served by .

Trunk Roads

Currently, Styrgate Road provides a bus stop that connects to this island.

Roads

This island consists of various pedestrian paths that forms a gridlike pattern and conntects across all facilities on this island.

Facilities

This island features a Station with its own Premium Lounge, three separate wings of NR Shops and an Outdoor Concert Hall as follows:

Kapa Channel Station

Kapa Channel Station is the station that serves as the railway hub of this island. It is located at the south of this island in terms of the island length, and is located at its center in terms of the island width. It is also located to the south of the Kapa Channel Premium Lounge, and connects with Peckern North to the west towards Poon Tong Station<!--, where connecting services are provided in the form of and -->, as well as Odyssey to the east towards Skyhorse Station, where further connections to the West Metropolis Archipelago Northeast and Express Services are provided by and respectively.

Kapa Channel Premium Lounge

Kapa Channel Premium Lounge is located to the direct north of station structure of Kapa Channel Station. It is also the first Premium Lounge to not be located within the station that serves it and is an indepenent two-storey structure.

West Wing NR Shops

On the west side of this island are 20 NR Shops that are coded KCH-01 to KCH-20, as well as two restaurant Shops, namely KCH-R01 and KCH-R02.

East Wing NR Shops

On the east side of this island are 20 additional NR Shops that are coded KCH-21 to KCH-40, as well as two restaurant Shops, namely KCH-R03 and KCH-R04.

South Wing NR Shops

Besides of the 44 NR Shops above, 17 shops are also placed directly to the south of Kapa Channel Station, cded KCH-41 to KCH-57.

Outdoor Concert Hall

The Outdoor Concert Hall is located directly to the north of Kapa Channel Premium Lounge and is sandwiched between the West and East Wings of the NR Shops. The Outdoor Concert Hall can serve up to an audience of 1,064 people in total.

Fun Facts

  • This artificial island is not reclaimed to the seabed. Instead, it is supported by a total of 96 support pillars that are built from the seabed. Therefore, this "Island" is better described as a Floating Platform. Nonetheless, this floating platform is named '''Kapa Channel Island''' for convenience purposes.
  • The size of this "island" can be contributed to the fact that it is also used as a Service Area of passengers using the bus stop on Styrgate Road for bus interchanges.

History

  • November 24 2024: The Station Structure of Kapa Channel Station began construction.
  • November 25 2024: This island completed reclamation works. At the same day, The Station Structure of Kapa Channel Station completed construction.
  • November 26 2024: Kapa Channel Station completed construction.
  • November 27 2024: Kapa Channel Station began services.

title: Katadelphia Depot
safeHtml:
'''Katadelphia Depot''' is the first depot to be built in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It is located at Los Sengas Katadelphia, and began services on May 5 2015. This Depot provides services for , , , , , , , , , , , , , and .

Description

Katadelphia Depot is located to the south of Katadelphia Station. It has a total land area of 11.6 Hectares, and has a total of 29 tracks that totals 15.36 km in length. The Depot is 845 m long and 120 m wide, with the main building being 431 m long.

Depot Structure

  • Stabling Sidings:
  • Main: 18 Sidings (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T), Stores a total of 36 trains, each with 8 carriages.
  • Auxiliar: 6 Sidings (U, V, W, X, Y Z), Stores a total of 5 trains, each with 8 carriages. However, upon expansion, it would be able to contain 10 to 20 8-carriage trains.
  • Depot Platforms:
  • A pair of Standard Length (204 m) Island Platforms.
  • Currently for Spare use and is not open to the public.
  • Does not feature Platform Screen Doors.
  • Maintenance Pit:
  • Located at the south of the depot. Two Maintenance Pits, each 244 m long, is set up for the convenience of vehicle maintenance.

The Depot has two sets of tracks connecting to the railway network, one to the east and one to the west:

  • Connecting Tracks:
  • West Entrance: Connects to Kata River Station Platforms 2, 3. Enters the depot from the underground.
  • East Entrance: Connects to the tracks between Katadelphia Station and Kaling Station.

title: Kelper Mount
safeHtml:
'''Kelper Mount''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Punctual. It is currently a well-developed new town that integrates elements of other players.

History

Development of Kelper Mount began in June 2017 when Nazca Railway constructed two roads and dozens of residential and commercial plots near Kelper Mount Station in hopes that players have more room and opportunity for urban development.

After Kelper Mount Station began services, a Building Team member constructed the Phase I of Kelper Mount New Town around the station. Phase I begun from the north, and contains a total of 136 plots, ending at Ka Yi Street to the south and Ka Chan Street to the west. To increase the convenience of access, a wrap to Kelper Mount New Town is also set up near the Spawn Point.

Due to the popularity of the plots, the Building Team Member proposed Phase II development of Kelper Mount New Town in the form of 70 additional plots to the southwest, as well as reserved space for public housing and hospitals. However, Kelper Mount has not seen any significant development since.

'''Kioku Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Location

'''Kioku Island''' is located to the northeast of Centopia Island and the southwest of Airship Island. It also sits at the northeastern edge of Centopia.

Transport

Railway

This island features Kioku Station of the , and it currently serves as a means of access between Centopia and Airship Island.

Road

Currently, this island features a main road connecting to Centopia Island to the west and Airship Island to the east, as well as two local roads. One road runs in parallel with the west coast, and the other runs in parallel with the north and northwest coasts. Kioku Station is located at the intersection between the main road and the second local road.

Fun Facts

  • The channel that exists between Centopia Island to the southwest and this island is 150m wide.
  • The name of this island '''Kioku''' is taken from the Japanese language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which means "Memory".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E3%81%8D%E3%81%8A%E3%81%8F#Japanese</ref>

Future Development

During the planning stages of , Kioku Station, the station that serves this island, was named '''Museum Station''', and when combined with the Chinese Name of this island, Memory, it implies that a museum may be built on this island in the future.

History

  • August 3 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • August 5 2023: This island completed road pavement, and the road link to Centopia Island completed construction.
  • August 29 2023: Kioku Station began services.
  • September 18 2023: The road link to Airship Island completed construction.
